title: server-authored UI text (family card): the approvals drawer's Approve says only "Approved.", and Explain access's Principal resolution prose names the user by raw id
body:

**Reader who acts:** the seat(s) owning `plugin-approvals` and `plugin-security` (triage routes; both rows are server-authored strings the console renders verbatim). A **family card**: one row per string. **Dedupe:** semantic issue search on this repo, closed included, "approval approve successMessage Approved names no request explain access principal raw user id holds positions" — 18 hits, none covers either string.

## Environment

objectstack `36b2889c` with the console built from objectui `1fb1ced36243` (the pin hop of objectstack-ai/objectstack#23104, since landed as `f451a5964`), stock `examples/app-showcase`, admin persona (and a member where noted). Every row reproduced at least twice on fresh loads by the runner; none is a regression of the pin hop (no hop commit touches the files named).

## Rows

| # | Location (objectstack `main`) | Reproduction | Expected |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.object.ts:474` — the approve action's declared `successMessage: 'Approved.'` | `/_console/apps/setup/component/approvals/inbox` → open a pending request (e.g. "Invoice Dual Sign-off (parallel approval)") → drawer → Approve → fill Comment → Confirm. `POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/ID/approve` 200 and the toast is the bare verb "Approved." (reproduced on INV-1001 and EXP-2001 requests). The inline row Approve on the same page already says `Approved "EXP-DEMO"`. | Success text naming what was approved, as the inline path does. |
| 2 | `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/explain-engine.ts:2061` — `Principal ${context?.userId …} holds position(s) …` | Studio → a writable package → More → Access → Explain access → User "Me (calling principal)", any object, Read → Explain → Evaluation pipeline › Principal resolution reads "Principal eycWvq… holds position(s) [platform_admin, …]" (2 fresh runs). The panel's own Principal line above already renders "Dev Admin admin@objectos.ai" with the id as a secondary line. | The person (name / email), the id at most secondary. The console half of this family is objectstack-ai/objectui#11862. |
